Integrations#

Every way to get a scene into Verse or a Verse scene onto a page, in one table: the platform, how the integration works, and how far it has been proven.

How to read the status column

StatusMeaning
testedproven end to end by a gate in this repo against a real server (and, where it applies, a real browser)
validatedthe code parses, type-checks and builds, and its schemas are checked, but it has not yet run on the live platform
skeletonthe shape is there; expect a first-run fix on the live platform
listing pending / npm publish pendingbuilt and tested, and works today by hand (paste, upload, private install), but the public store listing or npm package is not published yet — see the per-row note
in progressbeing built on a separate branch; not in this release

Embed on a page#

PlatformMethodStatusGuide
Any HTML page<verse-viewer> web component (<origin>/sdk/verse-viewer.js)tested · npm publish pending (@ctruhtech/verse-viewer)<verse-viewer>

Svelte, Angular, Lit, Astro, Qwikthe web component directlytested (same element)<verse-viewer>
Any HTML pagethe plain iframe from Studio → Embed; oEmbed (/oembed?url=)testedEmbed anywhere
WordPressplugin (auto-embed, [verse] shortcode, block), uploadable ziptested (plugin checks + server gate) · WordPress.org listing pendingEmbed anywhere
WooCommercethe same plugin 1.1.0: product panel, 3D view tab, gallery replacement, [verse_product], REST / Store API fieldsvalidated · not yet run on a live storeSell with WooCommerce
Shopifytheme app extension (product-page block, per-product metafield)validated · Shopify app listing pendingEmbed anywhere
WebflowCode Embed recipetested (snippet)Embed anywhere
WixEmbed HTML element; Velo page code + HtmlComponentvalidated · snippet tested on a host page · not yet run on a live siteEmbed in Wix
SquarespaceCode block snippetvalidated · snippet tested on a host page · not yet run on a live siteEmbed in Squarespace
BigCommercePage Builder widget template + Stencil partialvalidated · snippet tested on a host page · widget registered per store by handSell with BigCommerce
Framercode component with property controlsvalidated (tsc) · snippet tested on a host page · not yet run inside FramerEmbed in Framer
Magento / Adobe Commercemodule (product attribute, block, template)skeleton · needs a 2.4 test installSell with Magento
Ghostpaste the link (oEmbed discovery) or an HTML cardvalidated · snippet tested on a host page · discovery tags tested on the serverEmbed in Ghost and HubSpot
HubSpot CMSEmbed module, or the custom HubL module (hs upload)validated · snippet tested on a host page · not yet run on a live portalEmbed in Ghost and HubSpot
Elementor, any page builderpaste the HTML from Studio → Embed into the HTML blocktested (plain iframe)Embed anywhere

Every embed is the same poster-first card underneath: nothing of the engine downloads until the card is in view (or tapped), and views count as Arrived via: embed.

ToolMethodStatusGuide
Blenderadd-on / extension (verse_publish)shipped — verified in Blender 5.0.1Publish from Blender

FBX / OBJupload the file (or a zip with its textures)testedUpload FBX and OBJ
SketchUp, Rhino, 3ds Max, Revit, ArchiCADplug-in exports a GLB from inside the toolbeta (4.0.0-beta.1) — the upload core is tested against a real server; not yet run inside the host apps; each guide says what still needs a real installSketchUp · Rhino · 3ds Max · Revit · ArchiCAD
Maya, Cinema 4D, Houdini, SolidWorks, Figma, Splineplug-in exports a GLB from inside the tool (SolidWorks and Figma: skeletons; Spline: export a GLB and upload it; Figma: inserts a Verse link)beta (4.0.0-beta.1) — tested against fake hosts and a real server; not yet run inside the host appsMaya · Cinema 4D · Houdini · SolidWorks · Spline and Figma
Phone / tablet LiDAR and capture apps, 3D tour export bundles, laser scannersImport a scan (USDZ, GLB, OBJ zip, PLY, E57, XYZ / PTS, LAS / LAZ, a tour bundle's zip, splat PLY)testedImport a scan

What is tested where#

  • web/test/fix-verify-integrations.mjs — the web component, React and Vue in a real browser on a third-party origin; the REST round trip with a real webhook delivery; the upload-from-URL guard (units + live); every integrations/embeds/*/snippet.html on a host page; the embeds and automation check suites; this page and every guide above.
  • web/test/fix-verify-embeds.mjs — oEmbed, link unfurls, laziness, the COEP host, the plug-in checks, the Studio panel.
  • node integrations/embeds/check.mjs — PHP parses, JSON schemas, the Framer component type-checks, the plugin zip builds.
  • node integrations/automation/check.mjs — the Zapier schema and app tester, Make's structure, the n8n build and signature check.

Store listings and npm packages are not published yet; until they are, every integration above installs by hand from this repository.
